properties.name: The v0.58.0 version bump, and nothing else. `reflow2.toml` is a registered artifact, so moving the version string in it reads as drift; the design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and its epoch, not in a version string, so the design HOLDS. Accepted BEFORE `release_includes_all` freezes the manifest — the recorded trap is that freezing first records the release as having shipped the pre-bump file, which costs a gate failure and a second export.
